verify: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm test; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn test; else npm ci && npm test; fi

idioms: Detect the package manager from the lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml / yarn.lock / package-lock.json) and use only that one.
Match the client's module style (ESM vs CJS) from package.json "type" and existing imports.
Respect tsconfig strictness — if strict mode is on, no any-escapes.
Use the client's test runner (vitest/jest/node:test/mocha) — detect from devDependencies, never assume.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: Conventional Commits if their history uses them, otherwise imperative summary.
never: Never commit a regenerated lockfile unless dependency changes ARE the task.
Never add new devDependencies without flagging it in the PR description.
